title.zh: 对第 3591 号共和国法的修改
title.en: An Act Amending Sections 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. 10, 11, 13, 18, 22, 24, 26, and 28 of Republic Act No. 3591, as Amended, Otherwise Known as the Philippine Deposit Insurance Corporation Charter, and for Other Purposes

title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi một số điều của Đạo luật Cộng hòa số 3591 như đã được sửa đổi, và cho các mục đích khác
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขเพิ่มเติมบางมาตราแห่งพระราชบัญญัติแห่งสาธารณรัฐที่ 3591 ซึ่งแก้ไขเพิ่มเติมแล้ว และเพื่อวัตถุประสงค์อื่น
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah beberapa pasal Undang-Undang Republik No. 3591 sebagaimana diubah, dan untuk tujuan lain
title.ms: Akta meminda beberapa seksyen Akta Republik No. 3591 sebagaimana dipinda, dan untuk tujuan lain

text.en: The Cagayan de Oro Convention Center located at Barangay Indahag. Cagayan de Oro City is hereby renamed as Aquilino Q. Pimentel. Jr. International Convention Center.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
